rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best

positions.name: Exxon Mobil
positions.catalyst: Brent +3.8% to ~$108 / WTI ~$96 after Trump rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz; Houthi drones intercepted near Riyadh and Aramco areas. USO +4.5% premarket, but XOM only +1.8% (163.28 mid vs 160.59 close) and XLE +1.5% — producers lagging the crude move.
positions.driver: Risk-off Monday rotation out of tech/semis/metals (QQQ -1.0%, SOXL -6.8%, GLD -3%, SLV -4.7%) into energy. XOM is the liquid, low-beta way to own the oil shock with catch-up room vs crude; mega-cap balance sheet limits downside if the headline fades. Beat SOXS (+7% already — chasing), UCO (2x crude, +4.7% gapped, headline-reversal risk), SQQQ (3x, low conviction on a -1% tape), OXY (stale premarket book).
positions.risks: Headline whipsaw: any Hormuz de-escalation or Trump reversal could drop crude 5%+ in minutes. Buying a +1.8% gap. Broad market selloff could drag all equities. Hard stop 153.69 (-6%).
